entries.name: History
entries.content:
Kujou Sara is more than just a tengu fighter; she defines herself primarily through her obligations and aggression. According to her, tengu combatants have a specific duty to protect the forests and mountains. From a young age, she focused on these responsibilities.

Growing up in a forest filled with monsters, she suffered injuries and nearly lost her life before receiving her Vision. Instead of adopting her or taking her to a shrine, Yae chose to impose a “training” regimen that forced her into an ascetic lifestyle in the mountains during her childhood. Additionally, Yae orchestrated Sara's adoption by the Kujou clan due to her "unruly disposition."

Once Sara entered human society, she was immediately prepared for military duty and subjected to religious indoctrination by her adoptive father. He showed her little regard compared to his biological children, treating her—at times—like an instrument. Although she feels hurt by this treatment, her sense of indebtedness prevents her from acknowledging it.

Throughout her life among humans, Sara has known only subservience to the authority of Takayuki and the Shogun. During the Archon Quest, when confronting Takayuki, she remarks, "Ever since I was taken in by the Kujou Clan, you have taught me the importance of loyalty to superiors..."

Sara is unable to fully integrate into society; her tengu wings create a physical barrier that keeps her distant from others. The one time she attempted to forge friendships, her companions faced punishment, reinforcing her isolation. She harbors no personal desires outside of serving the Shogun.

Her training is obsessive and practically religious in intensity, following a regimen ten times more rigorous than that of ordinary troops. She does not have any hobbies; when asked about her interests, she references her archery practice but quickly clarifies that it is not a hobby—it's a lifelong discipline.

The deity she worships does not actually exist, raising doubts about whether any true god is even aware of her, despite her being one of the leading generals and carrying the title of "devotee of the divine." Regarding the concept of eternity, she states, "To manifest Eternity by the will of the Almighty Shogun — this is what I aspire to." However, she admits in "About the Raiden Shogun: Trust" that she does not fully understand the Shogun's intentions: "As I’m sure you’ve heard many times, the Almighty Shogun pursues Eternity — an existence beyond the grasp of thought and desire. 'Cast aside mortal tethers, strive for an unchanging Eternity'... The Almighty Shogun's stance is always resolute, and I do not always fully comprehend the meaning of her words. But this is her decision, and I trust in it."

Despite believing that the Raiden Shogun has determined and saved her life, Sara has consistently been manipulated by those around her, shaped into a compliant subordinate. Players often deceive her and allow others to take advantage of her throughout various quests, including the Archon Quest, the Labyrinth Warriors event, Kokomi's story quest, and the Irodori Festival.

Deceiving her is easy because the indoctrination has been so effective. She has become the perfect retainer and soldier, with her sole ambition being to serve. Unlike Takayuki, who aims to elevate the Kujou Clan, Sara has no personal goals that involve her in any meaningful way. Everything she does is to serve the Shogun, Inazuma, and the Clan as directly and earnestly as possible—this is all she knows.

Every aspect of her identity—as a tengu, a soldier, and a member of the Kujou clan—is equally significant to her, all representing her duty and service to the Shogun, Inazuma, and the Clan. Duty and service define her existence, as she has never experienced anything else.

entries.name: Vision hunt decree
entries.content:
The vision hunting decree was a measure taken by Raiden Shogun when the Shogun herself was manipulated by the Fatui, the decree was revoked.
Kujou Sara worked directly to enforce the measure, but believes that Raiden Shogun does not make mistakes and says that he only decided to do things differently.

entries.name: Tenryou Commision
entries.content:
Kujou Sara is an adopted daughter of the Kujou Clan, a general in the Tenryou Commission army.

The Tenryou Commission is responsible for the defense and protection of the Shogunate of Raiden Shogun. The Kujou Clan is just a clan of families.
